one_liner: Cloud work OS for project management, workflows, and team collaboration.

evidence.claim: API authenticates with personal V2 API tokens sent in the Authorization header
evidence.quote: The monday.com platform API utilizes **personal V2 API tokens** to authenticate requests and identify the user making the call.

evidence.claim: OAuth 2.0 is also supported as an authentication method for apps
evidence.quote: Your app can also use OAuth to get authentication tokens. Simply put, OAuth allows your app to ask for user authorization before accessing their account

evidence.claim: Free developer account with no expiration gives self-serve API access
evidence.quote: start playing around with our developer tools such as the API and apps framework on a free, no expiration date developer account!

evidence.claim: GraphQL API offers broad coverage across monday.com products and objects
evidence.quote: Broad platform coverage to read and modify boards, leads, docs, updates, and much more.

evidence.claim: Vendor officially ships and documents MCP servers for AI agent access
evidence.quote: monday.com provides full headless access to its platform through MCP servers, a GraphQL API, and typed SDKs. Any MCP-compatible AI tool connects natively.

notes: Official MCP server also published in the vendor's own GitHub org (mondaycom/mcp, package @mondaydotcomorg/monday-api-mcp). Gotchas: seamless auth only works inside an iframe; using a user's global API token means the app 'will not be approved for our marketplace'; personal tokens mirror UI permissions and regenerating a token immediately invalidates the old one.
